name: EV Nitrobenzene
description: The Church grew fat on ringed perfection, and still it hungered. Six carbons could not sate them. So the clergy tore open the veil and drew breath from below — and what they pulled through was not incense. Sulfur. Nitre. The exhalation of the pit itself, distilled into acid and poured over the sacrament. Behold the ring, defiled: a nitro group nailed to the holy hexagon like a heretic to a door. It burns hotter now. It burns better. And somewhere beneath the bedrock, something is very pleased with the arrangement.

annotations.text: In order to avoid shutdowns due to fluid overflow, void the excess and set up redstone to shut down the machine when all outputs are full. You can then safely set the machine to void excess. I personally see no use for the SO2 - I just void-hatched it ... but I suppose you could electrolyse it.

This part of the line is where you get infinite amounts of sulfuric- and nitric acid by creating a literal rift into hell. Turns out the winds of tartarus consist of some potent precursors to some much sought-after many-sided hydrogen-generous molecules. Simply place some air intake hatches in the nether and centrifuge. 

Protip: Craft up as many enchanted IV lootbags as you can and open them - these have a good chance of giving you some ender tanks or dimentional trancievers.
One EV LCR can comfortably do both.
This centrifuge only needs MV for this line, but you probably want to use nitrogen elsewhere as well.

2400L of nitrobenzene per second is going to net you 192,000 EU/t of raw fuel value - or 23.44 IV amps. In Large Gas Turbines with HSS-E Large Turbines in normal mode, this becomes 41.01 IV amps - or 336,000 EU/t.

To burn all this at optimal flow using that configuration would require exactly FOURTY (40) LGT's, which, in my opinion is a bit much considering the cost of HSS-E Large Turbines. Loose mode on the other hand requires only 8 (7,91), which, at 122% efficiency nets you 234.240 EU/t or 28,59 IV amps.

The investment is massive, but the payoff is as well. I haven't gotten that far, but I imagine the line remains usefull till long after you switched to a more advanced power setup.

Instead of a two-slice coke oven, you can also wallshare two of them very efficiently. See:https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1rsB5OOAkFgJ_lzhtVzWZc2aNCSo0e6lRhJG8Po7NZtY/edit?gid=825572672#gid=825572672
Enough lubricant for all you cutting and drilling needs.
Phenol for epoxid and PBI. 8640 EU/t in gas turbines.
Reservoir input hatch is available now.
To make a Chem Plant run on 2 EV amps, I believe you have to do 4 HV Energy Hatches - 2x EV ones made mine powerfail.
Toluene for TNT. 9840 EU/t in gas turbines.
This makes pthalic acid but its dubious wether you want to use that reciepe.

Since you will likely not be running the line at max capacity all the time, I suggest you set up some redstone that turns off the distillation only when all output hatches are full.

Another thing to note is that you should probably use some of these potent byproducts to power the line itself. I suppose you just have to guesstimate what can do what. Using HV singleblock turbines, A start would be to use the excess toluene to power the distillation towers.

The Dangote Distillus is gates behind IV energy hatches for both the main reciepe and the arcanite which requires iridium. A single one will easily handle this step twice over.
I also recommend looking into charcoal byproducts - especially after getting the distillus.
314 is a little less than 18x18 so a full HV 19x19 farm should be more than enough. I personally use the Farming Station - if the FS doesn't produce enough I have two words for you: Timewood Clocks.
To send overflow to the main net, I use super tanks with a fluid detector cover pointing at a redstone carded import bus on the main net - but thats bc my subnet is EnderIO.
